frontmatter.name: rankmath-seo-wp
frontmatter.description: Write Rank Math SEO-compliant WordPress articles in Traditional Chinese (or any language). Outputs Gutenberg block-paste-ready HTML with HowTo/FAQ blocks, focus keyword density 1.0-1.5%, 12 H2 structure, and SEO Title containing a digit.
frontmatter.author: moksa (https://moksaweb.com)

loaderBehaviour: Gemini CLI loads GEMINI.md via its hierarchical context system. The installer renames SKILL.md -> GEMINI.md to match the convention. References, tools, and data are copied alongside.
verificationNote: Gemini CLI's extension/skill loading is evolving. If your version doesn't auto-discover GEMINI.md inside extensions/, copy the content into the project-level GEMINI.md instead.
